alreadyOurs.first: O FOR a thousand tongues to sing
Sinners, turn, why will ye die?
Come, ye that love the Lord,
Behold the Saviour of mankind
O GOD! our help in ages past,
Thee we adore, eternal name!
Hark! a voice divides the sky,
Lo! He comes with clouds descending,
Jesu, Lover of my soul,
Out of the deep I cry,
Arise, my soul, arise,
And can it be, that I should gain
Arise, my soul, arise,
My God, the spring of all my joys,
Talk with us, Lord, thyself reveal,
See how great a flame aspires,
Praise ye the Lord! 'tis good to raise
Eternal Wisdom! Thee we praise,
God of my life, to thee
Holy as thou, O Lord, is none!
Father of me, and all mankind,
Father, in whom we live,
Holy, holy, holy Lord,
Soldiers of Christ, arise,
God of my life, whose gracious power
Lord, that I may learn of thee,
I WANT a principle within
A CHARGE to keep I have,
When quiet in my house I sit,
O FOR a heart to praise my God,
Thou hidden love of God, whose height,
O COME, and dwell in me,
I WANT the Spirit of power within,
I KNOW that my Redeemer lives,
Love Divine, all loves excelling,
Father, supply my every need,
Light of life, seraphic fire,
Lord, I believe a rest remains
Lo! God is here! let us adore,
Forgive us, for thy mercy's sake,
Father, at thy footstool see
Partners of a glorious hope,
Christ, whose glory fills the skies,
